import random
random.seed(880923)
N=50000
# multi-epoch causal basis toy
mixed=0; tuple_miss=0
for _ in range(N):
 b=random.randrange(1,1000000); g=b+(1 if random.random()<0.18 else 0); a=g if random.random()>=0.35 else b; f=g if random.random()>=0.22 else b
 bad=not(g==a==f); mixed+=bad; tuple_miss += (bad and g==a==f)
# compositional dynamic-dispatch closure
P=80; prim={p:set(random.randrange(500) for _ in range(random.randint(3,10))) for p in range(P)}
direct_escape=single_escape=union_escape=unknown=0; wd=wu=0
for _ in range(N):
 root=random.randrange(P); dynamic=random.random()<0.65; unk=dynamic and random.random()<0.05
 targets=set(random.sample(range(P),random.randint(2,5))) if dynamic else set(); actual=random.choice(list(targets)) if dynamic else None
 canon=lambda s:{x//3 for x in s}
 actualc=canon(prim[root] | (prim[actual] if actual is not None else set())); direct=canon(prim[root]); allc=canon(prim[root] | (set().union(*(prim[t] for t in targets)) if targets else set()))
 if dynamic: pred=next(iter(targets)); single=canon(prim[root]|prim[pred])
 else: single=direct
 direct_escape += not(actualc<=direct); single_escape += not(actualc<=single); unknown += unk; union_escape += (False if unk else not(actualc<=allc)); wd+=len(direct); wu+=len(allc)
# alias identity toy
true=rawmiss=0
for _ in range(N):
 x=random.randrange(4000)
 if random.random()<0.30:
  group=x//4; aliases=[group*4+j for j in range(4) if group*4+j!=x and group*4+j<4000]; y=random.choice(aliases)
 else: y=random.randrange(4000)
 if x//4==y//4: true+=1; rawmiss += x!=y
print({'n':N,'mixed_epoch_rate':mixed/N,'mixed_pass_after_tuple':tuple_miss/N,'direct_only_escape_rate':direct_escape/N,'single_predicted_target_escape_rate':single_escape/N,'closed_world_union_escape_rate':union_escape/N,'unknown_dispatch_escalation_rate':unknown/N,'mean_width_direct':wd/N,'mean_width_all_targets':wu/N,'alias_true_conflicts':true,'raw_alias_miss_rate_given_conflict':rawmiss/true})
